summary: Anthropic announced a further $20 million donation to Public First Action, bringing its total contribution to $40 million, to support AI policy education and advocate for its Advanced AI Framework and export-control tightening.

mechanisms.reason: Anthropic states it supports policy efforts to tighten export controls on advanced chips and equipment, though this is advocacy rather than an enacted restriction.
mechanisms.quote: we support policy efforts to tighten export controls on advanced chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment and to curb illicit model access and distillation attacks

practices.reason: The staged, trusted-access disclosure process used to find and patch high-severity vulnerabilities before public release describes an internal safety-testing practice, not a directly reproducible external method.
practices.quote: We chose to release it to a limited set of cyber defenders through Project Glasswing to enable trusted actors to find and fix those weaknesses before anyone could exploit them.
